name: Zodiac Signs
overview: Scripture acknowledges that God created the lights in the heavens, including the sun, moon, and stars, to serve as signs for seasons, days, and years (Genesis 1:14). However, the Bible warns believers against seeking guidance from the stars or times as a form of divination or enchantment, forbidding the observation of times for occult purposes (Leviticus 19:26; Deuteronomy 18:10). Additionally, God commands His people not to worship or serve the host of heaven, which He has allotted to other nations, nor to consult familiar spirits or wizards (Deuteronomy 4:19; Leviticus 19:31). Thus, while celestial bodies have a God-ordained role, using zodiac signs for guidance contradicts biblical teaching and reliance on God alone.
